# Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the running passive agent sessions.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus [[-Name] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus cmdlet writes the passive agent sessions running in this runspace, or the one named in -Name: each with its name, the host it answers as, when it started, and its Listener, the address and port it listens on. It reads only the runspace's own sessions and sends nothing. Start-ZbxPassiveAgent starts a session and Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent ends it.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: List the running passive agents

```powershell
Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus | Select-Object Name, Kind, Started
```

Every passive agent session of this runspace.

### Example 2: Find the port an agent listens on

```powershell
(Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus -Name 'web-agent').Listener.LocalEndPoint
```

Listener.LocalEndPoint is the address and port the server polls.

## PARAMETERS

### -Name

The session's name; every running passive-agent session when omitted.
